442	
443	原版击杀带**类型门**（WorldGen.cs:39146-39155 / 39193-39202）：
444	`if (Main.tile[x, num].type == Main.tile[x, j].type) KillTile(x, num);`——仅杀
445	type==被查格（165）的格。JS 曾 `if (flag) { kill(num); kill(num+1); }` 无条件双杀。
446	
447	现场（slab78 列 i=-1，入口 (dx-1,dy0/1) 有一对大理石地面钟乳石 fx=504 fy=36/54）：
448	j=1 放置大理石覆写 fy54 底格 → 邻查 fy36 顶格 → `type[b]!==type[a]` → flag3 →
449	**原版只杀 165 顶格；JS 把刚放的板格大理石一并抹掉** → 后续格 SmoothSlope mask
450	（12→实心 vs 4→半砖）分叉 → PlaceTight 门 SolidTile 掷（33 门/9 发 vs 更少）差 +15。
451	板上 165 被 ResetToType 覆写是 PlaceSlab 常态，故每 biome 都有数处此型分叉。

456	   仅回退此项即精确复现 van48/js63 原始分歧）；

458	   曾行主序；连环击杀的顺序语义）；
459	3. frame165（=WorldGen.TileFrame 生成期）**inactive 分支清 half/slope**
460	   （cs:82082-82086 TileFrame 头部 inactive → halfBrick(false)+slope(0)——MS slope
461	   网对拍口径）。

464	——**错**：Tile.cs 的 `wall` 是独立 `ushort` 字段（:12），不在 bTileHeader，ResetToType
465	不清墙；该改动立刻打坏 biome1（slab61 差 1 掷）即回退。

// 普通世界全链（4200×1200），UnifiedRandom 反射真·Terraria.exe（零转写风险）。
// 每 pass 后输出 type/active/wall/liquid 的 FNV-1a 哈希 → JSON，
// 与 JS 侧 tests/pass-hash.test.ts 的洞穴链检查点对账。
// 用法：dotnet run tools/golden/caves-oracle.cs <seedInt> <evil:0|1> <out.json>
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Text;

int seed = int.Parse(args[0]);
int evil = int.Parse(args[1]);
string outPath = args[2];
// 多尺寸支持（2026-08-16）：第 4 参 size ∈ {0小,1中,2大}（默认 0）——GetWorldSize() 语义
int worldSize = args.Length > 3 ? int.Parse(args[3]) : 0;
int W = worldSize == 1 ? 6400 : worldSize == 2 ? 8400 : 4200;
int H = worldSize == 1 ? 1800 : worldSize == 2 ? 2400 : 1200;
const int BEACH_DISTANCE = 380; // WorldGen.beachDistance（cs:4102）

Type URType = asm.GetType("Terraria.Utilities.UnifiedRandom")!;

var checkpoints = new List<string>();

static byte[] ToBytes(ushort[] a) { var b = new byte[a.Length * 2]; Buffer.BlockCopy(a, 0, b, 0, b.Length); return b; }
uint Fnv16(ushort[] a) { uint h = 0x811c9dc5; foreach (var v in a) { h = (h ^ (uint)(v & 0xff)) * 16777619u; h = (h ^ (uint)((v >> 8) & 0xff)) * 16777619u; } return h; }
static uint Fnv8(byte[] a) { uint h = 0x811c9dc5; foreach (var v in a) { h = (h ^ v) * 16777619u; h = h * 16777619u; } return h; }
// 只比活性 type（非活性格的幽灵 type 归零——与 JS 侧 hashGrids 口径一致；

var hashTyp = new ushort[W * H];

var ghostPts = new List<string>();
void Checkpoint(string name)
{
    for (int i = 0; i < typ.Length; i++) {
        hashTyp[i] = (ushort)(act[i] != 0 ? typ[i] : 0);
        hashGho[i] = (ushort)(act[i] == 0 ? typ[i] : 0); // inactive 格残留 type（幽灵 parity）
    }
    checkpoints.Add($"{name}|{Fnv16(hashTyp):x8} {Fnv8(act):x8} {Fnv16(wal):x8} {Fnv8(liq):x8}");
    ghostPts.Add($"{name}|{Fnv16(hashGho):x8}");
    // GRID_DUMP=pyramids:/tmp/cs-pyr → 命中检查点时落 typ(LE16)/act/wal(LE16)/liq 裸数组（对拍用）
    var gd = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("GRID_DUMP");
    if (gd != null && gd.Split(':')[0] == name)
    {
        string p = gd.Split(':')[1];
        File.WriteAllBytes(p + ".typ", ToBytes(typ));
        File.WriteAllBytes(p + ".act", act);
        File.WriteAllBytes(p + ".wal", ToBytes(wal));
        File.WriteAllBytes(p + ".liq", liq);
        Console.WriteLine($"griddump {name} -> {p}");
    }
    // STATE_DUMP=dirtwallcleanup:/tmp/cs-st39 → 同上 + UnifiedRandom 内部态（结构段状态恢复对拍：

    var sd = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("STATE_DUMP");
    if (sd != null && sd.Split(':')[0] == name)
    {
        string p2 = sd.Split(':')[1];
        using var fs = File.Create(p2);
        using var bw = new BinaryWriter(fs);
        var urt = asm.GetType("Terraria.Utilities.UnifiedRandom")!;
        var usa = (int[])urt.GetField("SeedArray", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance)!.GetValue(r)!;
        var uix = (uint)urt.GetField("inext", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance)!.GetValue(r)!;
        bw.Write(W); bw.Write(H); bw.Write(uix);
        for (int q = 0; q < 56; q++) bw.Write(usa[q]);
        bw.Write(act, 0, act.Length);
        bw.Write(ToBytes(typ), 0, W * H * 2);
        bw.Write(ToBytes(wal), 0, W * H * 2);
        bw.Write(liq, 0, liq.Length);
        bw.Write(liqT, 0, liqT.Length);
        Console.WriteLine($"statedump {name} -> {p2}");

}

function hashGrids(st: { type: Uint16Array; flags: Uint8Array; liquid: Uint8Array; wall: Uint16Array; w: number; h: number }) {
  const n = st.w * st.h;
  const mapped = new Uint16Array(n);
  const ghost = new Uint16Array(n);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const v = V_ID[st.type[i]];
    if (st.flags[i]) mapped[i] = v < 0 ? 0x7fff : v;
    else ghost[i] = v < 0 ? 0x7fff : v; // 幽灵 parity：inactive 格的残留 type
  }
  return `${fnv1a(mapped)} ${fnv1a(st.flags)} ${fnv1a(st.liquid)}`;
}

 *  以墙(187/216)为核心输出，从这里开始逐哈希比对。 */
function hashWalls(st: { wall: Uint16Array }): string {
  return fnv1a(st.wall);
}

        'livingtrees', 'livingtreewalls', 'altars', 'surfacewaterinjungle'];
      let firstBad = '';
      for (const n of names) {
        if (ours.get(n) !== gold.get(n) && !firstBad) firstBad = n;
        console.log(`${n.padEnd(14)} ${ours.get(n)} vs ${gold.get(n)} ${ours.get(n) === gold.get(n) ? '✓' : '✗'}`);

9974	    {

9976	        bool flag = Math.Abs(y1 - y0) > Math.Abs(x1 - x0);
9977	        if (flag) { (x0, y0) = (y0, x0); (x1, y1) = (y1, x1); }
9978	        int num = Math.Abs(x1 - x0), num2 = Math.Abs(y1 - y0);
9979	        int num3 = num / 2, num4 = y0;

10017	        }, jump: true);

function shroomPatch(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, i: number, j: number): void {

  const van = st.w / 4200;                          // num3 缩放(cs:80567;FTW ×1.5 未接)
  let num = rng.int(80, 99) * van;                 // Next(80,100) × 缩放——num 曾漏乘(2026-08-12 审计)
  let num2 = rng.int(20, 25) * van;                // Next(20,26) × 缩放
  const num4 = num2 - 1;                           // 首圈标记
  let px = i + 0.0, py = j - num2 * 0.3;
  let vx = rng.int(-100, 100) * 0.005;
  let vy = rng.int(-200, -101) * 0.005;
  while (num > 0 && num2 > 0) {
    num -= rng.int(0, 2);                          // Next(3)
    num2 -= 1;
    const x0 = Math.max(0, Math.trunc(px - num * 0.5));
    const x1 = Math.min(st.w, Math.trunc(px + num * 0.5));
    const y0 = Math.max(0, Math.trunc(py - num * 0.5));
    const y1 = Math.min(st.h, Math.trunc(py + num * 0.5));
    const r = num * rng.int(80, 119) * 0.01;
    for (let x = x0; x < x1; x++) {
      for (let y = y0; y < y1; y++) {
        const ddx = Math.abs(x - px);
        const ddy = Math.abs((y - py) * 2.3);
        const d = Math.sqrt(ddx * ddx + ddy * ddy);
        const ti = st.idx(x, y);
        if (d < r * 0.8 && st.liquidType[ti] === 2) st.liquid[ti] = 0;   // tile.lava()
        if (d < r * 0.2 && y < py) {
          st.flags[ti] = 0;                          // active(false)：type 保留（幽灵，同原版）
          if (st.wall[ti] > 0) st.wall[ti] = 80;
        } else if (d < r * 0.4 * (0.95 + rng.next() * 0.1)) {
          st.type[ti] = MUD;                        // type 恒写（active 另判）
          if (num2 === num4 && y > py) st.flags[ti] = 1;
          if (st.wall[ti] > 0) st.wall[ti] = 80;
        }
      }
    }
    px += vx; py += vy;
    px += vx;                                       // 原版 val+=val2 后再 val.X+=val2.X
    vx += rng.int(-100, 109) * 0.005;
    vy -= rng.int(0, 109) * 0.005;                  // Next(110)
    if (vx > -0.5 && vx < 0.5) vx = vx < 0 ? -0.5 : 0.5;
    if (vx > 0.5) vx = 0.5;
    if (vx < -0.5) vx = -0.5;
    if (vy > 0.5) vy = 0.5;
    if (vy < -0.5) vy = -0.5;
    for (let m = 0; m < 2; m++) {
      let x = Math.trunc(px) + rng.int(-20, 19);
      let y = Math.trunc(py) + rng.int(0, 19);
      // 原版拒绝环：落点非活性且非泥则重掷（无界重掷→落地即活性/泥）
      while (x >= 0 && x < st.w && y >= 0 && y < st.h
        && !st.flags[st.idx(x, y)] && st.type[st.idx(x, y)] !== MUD) {
        x = Math.trunc(px) + rng.int(-20, 19);
        y = Math.trunc(py) + rng.int(0, 19);
      }
      tileRunner(st, rng, gs, x, y, {
        strength: rng.int(10, 19), steps: rng.int(10, 19),   // Next(10,20)×2
        type: MUD, speedY: 2, noYChange: true,
      });
    }
  }
}

166	function marblePlace(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, ox0: number, oy0: number): boolean {
167	  if (biomeTileCheck(st, ox0, oy0)) return false;
168	  const bn = Math.trunc(rng.int(80, 149) / 3);          // Next(80,150)/3
169	  const bn2 = Math.trunc(rng.int(40, 59) / 3);          // Next(40,60)/3
170	  const bn3 = Math.trunc((bn2 * 3 - rng.int(20, 29)) / 3);
171	  const ox = ox0 - Math.trunc(bn * 3 / 2), oy = oy0 - Math.trunc(bn2 * 3 / 2);
172	  // Slab 状态机：0空 1实心 2半砖 3右下 4左下 5右上 6左上
173	  const state: number[][] = [];
174	  const hasWall: boolean[][] = [];
175	  for (let i = 0; i < bn + 2; i++) { state.push(new Array(bn2 + 2).fill(0)); hasWall.push(new Array(bn2 + 2).fill(false)); }
176	  const groupSolid = (x: number, y: number): boolean => {
177	    let cnt = 0;
178	    for (let a = 0; a < 3; a++) for (let b = 0; b < 3; b++) if (solidOrSlopedAt(st, x + a, y + b)) cnt++;
179	    return cnt > 0;                                     // scale/4*3 = 0（int 除）；IsGroupSolid 用 SolidOrSlopedTile
180	  };
181	  for (let i = -1; i < bn + 1; i++) {
182	    const n4 = (i - Math.trunc(bn / 2)) / bn + 0.5;
183	    const n5 = Math.trunc((0.5 - Math.abs(n4 - 0.5)) * 5) - 2;
184	    for (let j = -1; j < bn2 + 1; j++) {
185	      let wall = true, solid = false;
186	      const g2 = groupSolid(i * 3 + ox, j * 3 + oy);
187	      const n6 = Math.abs(j - Math.trunc(bn2 / 2)) - Math.trunc(bn3 / 4) + n5;
188	      if (n6 > 3) { solid = g2; wall = false; }
189	      else if (n6 > 0) { solid = j - Math.trunc(bn2 / 2) > 0 || g2; wall = j - Math.trunc(bn2 / 2) < 0 || n6 <= 2; }
190	      else if (n6 === 0) solid = rng.int(0, 1) === 0 && (j - Math.trunc(bn2 / 2) > 0 || g2);
191	      if (Math.abs(n4 - 0.5) > 0.35 + rng.next() * 0.1 && !g2) { wall = false; solid = false; }
192	      state[i + 1]![j + 1] = solid ? 1 : 0;
193	      hasWall[i + 1]![j + 1] = wall;
194	    }
195	  }
196	  const slabSolid = (s: number, lx: number, ly: number, scale: number): boolean => {
197	    switch (s) {
198	      case 0: return false;
199	      case 1: return true;
200	      case 2: return ly >= Math.trunc(scale / 2);
201	      case 3: return lx >= scale - ly;
202	      case 4: return lx < ly;
203	      case 5: return lx > ly;
204	      case 6: return lx < scale - ly;
205	      default: return true;
206	    }
207	  };
208	  // SmoothSlope（MarbleBiome.cs:79-110）：4 邻实心码 → 状态重分类
209	  for (let i = 0; i < bn; i++) {
210	    for (let j = 0; j < bn2; j++) {
211	      const sx = i + 1, sy = j + 1;
212	      if (state[sx]![sy] === 0) continue;
213	      const code = ((state[sx]![sy - 1] !== 0 ? 1 : 0) << 3)
214	        | ((state[sx]![sy + 1] !== 0 ? 1 : 0) << 2)
215	        | ((state[sx - 1]![sy] !== 0 ? 1 : 0) << 1)
216	        | (state[sx + 1]![sy] !== 0 ? 1 : 0);
217	      state[sx]![sy] = code === 10 ? 6 : code === 9 ? 5 : code === 6 ? 4 : code === 5 ? 3 : code === 4 ? 2 : 1;
218	    }
219	  }
220	  const bn7 = Math.trunc(bn / 2), bn8 = Math.trunc(bn2 / 2);
221	  const bn9 = (bn8 + 1) * (bn8 + 1);
222	  const vv = rng.next() * 2 - 1, vv2 = rng.next() * 2 - 1, vv3 = rng.next() * 2 - 1;
223	  let n11 = 0;
224	  for (let m = 0; m <= bn; m++) {
225	    const n12 = bn8 / bn7 * (m - bn7);
226	    const n13 = Math.min(bn8, Math.trunc(Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, bn9 - n12 * n12))));
227	    n11 = m >= Math.trunc(bn / 2)
228	      ? n11 + (vv2 + (vv3 - vv2) * (m / Math.trunc(bn / 2) - 1))
229	      : n11 + (vv + (vv2 - vv) * (m / Math.trunc(bn / 2)));
230	    for (let n = bn8 - n13; n <= bn8 + n13; n++) {
231	      // PlaceSlab（scale=3）
232	      const pOX = m * 3 + ox, pOY = n * 3 + oy + Math.trunc(n11);
233	      const pst = state[m + 1]![n + 1]!, pWall = hasWall[m + 1]![n + 1]!;
234	      const __probe = (globalThis as { __swSlabProbe?: (x: number, y: number, pst: number, pWall: boolean) => void }).__swSlabProbe;
235	      if (__probe) __probe(pOX, pOY, pst, pWall);
236	      let pn4 = 0, pn5 = 3;
237	      for (let i = -1; i < 4; i++) {
238	        if ((i === -1 || i === 3) && rng.int(0, 1) === 0) continue;   // 边缘列 50% 跳过
239	        if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) pn4--;
240	        if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) pn5++;
241	        for (let j = pn4; j < pn5; j++) {
242	          const px = pOX + i, py = pOY + j;
243	          if (!st.inBounds(px, py)) continue;
244	          const ti = st.idx(px, py);
245	          st.type[ti] = isOreType(st.type[ti]) ? st.type[ti] : MARBLE;  // ResetToType：矿石保留
246	          st.flags[ti] = slabSolid(pst, i, j, 3) ? 1 : 0;
247	          st.liquid[ti] = 0; st.liquidType[ti] = 0;
248	          st.half[ti] = 0; st.slope[ti] = 0;  // ResetToType 清 sTileHeader（半砖/坡面）
249	          // ★wall 是 Tile.cs 独立 ushort 字段——ResetToType 的 bTileHeader*=0 不清墙，
250	          // HasWall=false 时保留旧墙（SquareWallFrame 掷照旧）
251	          if (pWall) st.wall[ti] = 178;
252	          // WorldUtils.TileFrame(frameNeighbors:true)（cs:WorldUtils.cs:79-88）：
253	          // 中心 + (x+1,y)/(x-1,y)/(x,y+1)/(x,y-1) 各一次 TileFrameImportant——
254	          // 165 格 → CheckStalactite 重查（支撑被后续格上坡 → 击杀/重定型掷）
255	          frame165(st, rng, px, py);
256	          frame165(st, rng, px + 1, py);
257	          frame165(st, rng, px - 1, py);
258	          frame165(st, rng, px, py + 1);
259	          frame165(st, rng, px, py - 1);
260	          // SquareWallFrame：中心格 WallFrame(resetFrame:true) 非零墙掷 1×Next(0,3)
261	          //（PlaceSlab 每格,cs:MarbleBiome.cs:160-168）
262	          squareWallFrameRoll(st, rng, px, py);
263	          // Tile.SmoothSlope（applyToNeighbors=true）：无掷但写 half/slope——
264	          // 影响本列/邻列后续 SolidTile 门（PlaceTight 骰）与最终坡面
265	          tileSmoothSlope(st, px, py);
266	          if (solidTileAt(st, px, py - 1) && rng.int(0, 3) === 0) placeTight(st, rng, px, py);
267	          if (solidTileAt(st, px, py) && rng.int(0, 3) === 0) placeTight(st, rng, px, py - 1);
268	        }
269	      }
270	    }
271	  }
272	  return true;

275	/** cs:12884-12975：采样与放置两段分离——先收点（CanPlace = !BiomeTileCheck && !active），
276	 *  再统一 Place。带宽 (w-200)/num。 */
277	export function runGranitePass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState): void {
278	  let count = worldGenRangeCount(st, rng, 4, 8, 'width');
279	  const pts: Array<[number, number]> = [];
280	  let placed = 0, fails = 0;
281	  while (placed < count) {
282	    const frac = placed / count;
283	    let x = 0, y = 0, ok = false;
284	    let budget = 100;
285	    while (!ok) {
286	      budget--;
287	      if (budget <= 0) break;
288	      const x0 = Math.trunc(frac * (st.w - 200)) + 100;
289	      x = rng.int(x0, x0 + Math.trunc((st.w - 200) / count) - 1);
290	      const y0 = Math.trunc(gs.genRockLayer) + 20;
291	      y = rng.int(y0, y0 + (st.h - (Math.trunc(gs.genRockLayer) + 40) - 200) - 1);
292	      while (x > st.w * 0.45 && x < st.w * 0.55) x = rng.int(gs.beachDistance, st.w - gs.beachDistance - 1);
293	      ok = true;
294	    }
295	    fails++;
296	    if (ok && !biomeTileCheck(st, x, y) && !(st.inBounds(x, y) && st.flags[st.idx(x, y)])) {
297	      pts.push([x, y]); placed++;
298	    } else if (fails > st.w * 10) { count = placed; placed++; fails = 0; }
299	  }
300	  for (let i = 0; i < count && i < pts.length; i++) granitePlace(st, rng, gs, pts[i]![0]!, pts[i]![1]!);
301	}

303	/** GraniteBiome.Place（GraniteBiome.cs:73-353）1:1：magma 压力 CA → 放置 → 清理 → 装饰 */
304	function granitePlace(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, x0: number, y0: number): void {
305	  if (!st.inBounds(x0, y0) || st.flags[st.idx(x0, y0)]) return;
306	  const gox = x0 - 100, goy = y0 - 100;             // 200×200 magma 图
307	  // let:轮末 Utils.Swap 引用交换(GraniteBiome.cs:186)
308	  let pres = new Float64Array(200 * 200);
309	  let res = new Float64Array(200 * 200);
310	  let mact = new Uint8Array(200 * 200);
311	  for (let a = 0; a < 200; a++) {
312	    for (let b = 0; b < 200; b++) {
313	      res[a * 200 + b] = solidTileAt(st, a + gox, b + goy) ? 4 : 1;
314	    }
315	  }
316	  // 8 邻域单位向量（Vector2D.Normalize）
317	  const NVX = [-Math.SQRT1_2, -1, -Math.SQRT1_2, 0, 0, 0, Math.SQRT1_2, 1, Math.SQRT1_2];
318	  const NVY = [-Math.SQRT1_2, 0, Math.SQRT1_2, -1, 0, 1, -Math.SQRT1_2, 0, Math.SQRT1_2];
319	  let x3 = 100, x4 = 100, y3 = 100, y4 = 100;
320	  // ★原版双缓冲稀疏写+轮末 Swap(GraniteBiome.cs:47-49/:186-187):target 在
321	  //  BuildMagmaMap 时全新(全 0),循环只写被激活/过压力门的格,轮末交换数组引用——
322	  //  本轮未写格保留 **i-2 轮**值。曾每轮 tPres.set(pres) 全量刷新 → 未写格保留
323	  //  i-1 轮值,CA 边界低压力格行为分叉
324	  // ★BuildMagmaMap(GraniteBiome.cs:96-107):target 缓冲初始为 source 的**别名拷贝**
325	  //  (未写格 Resistance 恒保持地形初值 1/4,非全 0)——曾 new 全 0 数组,CA 边界
326	  //  电阻场差一个量级(oracle 对账揪出;此前为对齐 JS 曾在 oracle 镜像 0 初值,现
327	  //  双侧回正原版语义)
328	  const tPres0 = Float64Array.from(pres);
329	  const tRes0 = Float64Array.from(res);
330	  const tAct0 = Uint8Array.from(mact);
331	  let tPres = tPres0, tRes = tRes0, tAct = tAct0;
332	  const clamp = (v: number, lo: number, hi: number) => Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, v));
333	  for (let it = 0; it < 300; it++) {
334	    for (let j = x3; j <= x4; j++) {
335	      for (let k = y3; k <= y4; k++) {
336	        const ji = j * 200 + k;
337	        if (!mact[ji]) continue;
338	        let sum = 0, vx = 0, vy = 0;
339	        for (let l = -1; l <= 1; l++) {
340	          for (let m = -1; m <= 1; m++) {
341	            if (l === 0 && m === 0) continue;
342	            const vi = (l + 1) * 3 + (m + 1);
343	            const ni = (j + l) * 200 + (k + m);
344	            const np = pres[ni]!;
345	            if (pres[ji]! > 0.01 && !mact[ni]) {
346	              if (l === -1) x3 = clamp(j + l, 1, x3); else x4 = clamp(j + l, x4, 198);
347	              if (m === -1) y3 = clamp(k + m, 1, y3); else y4 = clamp(k + m, y4, 198);
348	              // ToFlow(:31):保压/保阻,置 active——稀疏写下须整格写入 target
349	              tPres[ni] = pres[ni]!; tRes[ni] = res[ni]!; tAct[ni] = 1;
350	            }
351	            sum += np;
352	            vx += np * NVX[vi]!; vy += np * NVY[vi]!;
353	          }
354	        }
355	        sum /= 8;
356	        if (sum > res[ji]!) {
357	          const len = Math.sqrt(vx * vx + vy * vy) / 8;
358	          let nv = Math.max(sum - len - pres[ji]!, 0) + len + pres[ji]! * 0.875 - res[ji]!;
359	          nv = Math.max(0, nv);
360	          tPres[ji] = nv;
361	          tRes[ji] = Math.max(0, res[ji]! - nv * 0.02);
362	          // CreateFlow(:31)恒 active:true——整格写入含激活位。曾只写压力/电阻：
363	          // 稀疏交换语义下本格 target 残留 i-2 轮 inactive 态 → CA 细胞提前死亡、
364	          // 花岗岩腔边界比原版小一圈（wall 180 网大面积缺失）

367	      }
368	    }
369	    // CreateFlow(25.0) 默认 resistance=0(:34)——中心注入须清 tRes(曾残留初值
370	    // 1/4,中心压差差一个量级并外传全图)
371	    if (it < 2) { tPres[100 * 200 + 100] = 25; tRes[100 * 200 + 100] = 0; tAct[100 * 200 + 100] = 1; }
372	    // Utils.Swap(引用交换,零拷贝)
373	    let tp = pres; pres = tPres; tPres = tp;
374	    tp = res; res = tRes; tRes = tp;
375	    let tq = mact; mact = tAct; tAct = tq;
376	  }
377	  // ShouldUseLava：中心线 ≤ lavaLine-30 免岩浆；±50 内有冰雪/薄冰(161-163)/200 拒绝
378	  const useLava = (() => {
379	    if (goy + 100 <= gs.lavaLine - 30) return false;
380	    for (let a = -50; a < 50; a++) {
381	      for (let b = -50; b < 50; b++) {
382	        const ax = gox + 100 + a, ay = goy + 100 + b;
383	        if (ax >= 10 && ax < st.w - 10 && ay >= 10 && ay < st.h - 10 && st.flags[st.idx(ax, ay)]) {
384	          const t = TILE_DEFS[st.type[st.idx(ax, ay)]]?.vanilla?.sheet ?? 0;
385	          if (t === 147 || t === 200 || (t >= 161 && t <= 163)) return false;
386	        }
387	      }
388	    }
389	    return true;
390	  })();
391	  // PlaceGranite
392	  for (let i = x3; i <= x4; i++) {
393	    for (let j = y3; j <= y4; j++) {
394	      const mi = i * 200 + j;
395	      const tx = gox + i, ty = goy + j;
396	      if (tx < 10 || tx >= st.w - 10 || ty < 10 || ty >= st.h - 10 || !mact[mi]) continue;
397	      const ti = st.idx(tx, ty);
398	      const gnum = Math.sin((goy + j) * 0.4) * 0.7 + 1.2;
399	      const gnum2 = 0.2 + 0.5 / Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, pres[mi]! - res[mi]!));
400	      if (Math.max(1 - Math.max(0, gnum * gnum2), pres[mi]! / 15) > 0.35 + (solidTileAt(st, tx, ty) ? 0 : 0.5)) {
401	        st.type[ti] = isOreType(st.type[ti]) ? st.type[ti] : GRANITE;
402	        st.flags[ti] = 1; st.liquid[ti] = 0; st.liquidType[ti] = 0;
403	        st.half[ti] = 0; st.slope[ti] = 0;           // ResetToType 清 sTileHeader
404	        st.wall[ti] = 180;
405	      } else if (res[mi]! < 0.01) {
406	        st.flags[ti] = 0;                            // ClearTile：type/wall/液体保留
407	        st.half[ti] = 0; st.slope[ti] = 0;           // ClearSlope
408	        st.wall[ti] = 180;
409	      }
410	      if (st.liquid[ti] > 0 && useLava) st.liquidType[ti] = 2;
411	    }
412	  }
413	  // CleanupTiles：3×3 实心邻 <3 的活性花岗岩清除
414	  const clean: Array<[number, number]> = [];
415	  for (let i = x3; i <= x4; i++) {
416	    for (let j = y3; j <= y4; j++) {
417	      if (!mact[i * 200 + j]) continue;
418	      const tx = gox + i, ty = goy + j;
419	      if (tx < 10 || tx >= st.w - 10 || ty < 10 || ty >= st.h - 10 || !solidTileAt(st, tx, ty)) continue;
420	      let cnt = 0;
421	      for (let a = -1; a <= 1; a++) for (let b = -1; b <= 1; b++) if (solidTileAt(st, tx + a, ty + b)) cnt++;
422	      if (cnt < 3) clean.push([tx, ty]);
423	    }
424	  }
425	  for (const [cx, cy] of clean) {
426	    const ti = st.idx(cx, cy);
427	    st.flags[ti] = 0; st.wall[ti] = 180;
428	    st.half[ti] = 0; st.slope[ti] = 0;               // ClearTile→ClearSlope
429	  }
430	  // PlaceDecorations：FastRandom(seed).WithModifier(65440) 独立流（与 genRand 无关）
431	  const fr = new FastRandom(gs.seed).withModifier(65440);
432	  for (let i = x3; i <= x4; i++) {

434	      const mi = i * 200 + j;
435	      const tx = gox + i, ty = goy + j;

// 1:1 移植:以太生物群系——圆形石壳(型 1)+ 腔体挖空 + 底部微光液 +
// 两侧隧道开口 + (num==0 时)地表石笋柱 + aether 宝石树。
// ★checkpoint 金标对账:tools/golden/caves-oracle.cs Shimmer 段(1456 注册序
//   Gems(15109)<GravitatingSand(15198)<OceanCaves(15228)<Shimmer(15256))+
//   tests/shimmer-checkpoint.test.ts——全链与"状态恢复"双通道,四段落检查点
//   (shimmershell/shimmerpillars/shimmeropen/shimmer)+RNG 流指纹+落点坐标逐项全等。
// 位置(cs:15274-15275):地牢异侧 dungeonSide<Right → Next(0.89w, w-200),
// 否则 Next(200, 0.11w);y∈[(ws+rl)/2+50, ((h-250)*2+rl)/3](失败重掷见下)。
// 失败重试(cs:15283-15300):前 1e4 次不变 x 带;>20000 次放宽到 0.8/0.2 带,
// y 下限改为 ws+120;成功后 GenVars.shimmerPosition → gs.shimmerX/Y。
// aether 树(cs:35057-35083):500 次 X±70 / Y±2 采样,两侧整砖即种
// TryGrowingTreeByType(583-589 宝石树)——实现见 TreePass.growGemTree(GrowTreeWithSettings
// 1:1,含 GemTreeGroundTest 石/苔 + WallTest 洞穴墙)。砍伐掉落与树苗再生长均已接:
// Game.fellImportedTree(KillTile_GetItemDrops :65754-65802 + SetGemTreeDrops,1/10 宝石
// /9/10 石块,干基 50% gemcorn 4851-4857)与 Game.growSaplings(590 树苗地下 1/5,
// :72924-72960)。(2026-08-12 头注曾过时声称未接,已核正)
import type { TileStore } from '../../TileStore';
import type { RNG } from '../../../core/rng';
import type { GenState } from './GenState';
import { addProtectedStructure } from './GenState';
import { TILE_BY_KEY, TILE_DEFS } from '../../../data/tiles';
import { idsByVanillaSheet } from './TileRunner';
import { genSolidType } from './GenSolid';
import { solidTile } from './HalfBrickPass';
import { growGemTree } from './TreePass';

/** Main.tileMoss（TileID.cs）：苔藓族 sheet 集（石族钟乳石帧判定用） */
const MOSS_SHEETS = new Set<number>(Array.from(idsByVanillaSheet(182, 180, 179, 381, 183, 181, 534, 536, 539, 625, 627)).map((id) => TILE_DEFS[id]?.vanilla?.sheet ?? -1));

const STONE = TILE_BY_KEY['stone']!;         // 原版 type 1
const STALACTITE = TILE_BY_KEY['v_165_cave_decos']!; // 原版 type 165(PlaceTight)
const CRIMSTONE = TILE_BY_KEY['v_203_crimstone_block']!;
const EBONSTONE = TILE_BY_KEY['v_25_ebonstone_block']!;
const LIQ_SHIMMER = 4; // 原版 liquidType 3(shimmer)→ 本仓库 +1 编码
/** aether 宝石树 tile 表（cs:35063-35079 num24=0..6 → treeTileType） */
const GEM_TREES = [
  TILE_BY_KEY['v_583_topaz_tree']!,
  TILE_BY_KEY['v_584_amethyst_tree']!,
  TILE_BY_KEY['v_585_sapphire_tree']!,
  TILE_BY_KEY['v_586_emerald_tree']!,
  TILE_BY_KEY['v_587_ruby_tree']!,
  TILE_BY_KEY['v_588_diamond_tree']!,
  TILE_BY_KEY['v_589_amber_tree']!,
];

/**
 * 段落检查点回调（tests/shimmer-checkpoint.test.ts 消费；C# oracle 的
 * Checkpoint("shimmershell"/…) 同名落点）。失败重掷的 ShimmerMakeBiome 调用在
 * 越界/邪化石门即 return false——先于一切写格段，故回调只在成功尝试内触发，
 * 与 oracle 单次成功尝试内的检查点一一对应。
 */
export type ShimmerStageCallback = (name: 'shimmershell' | 'shimmerpillars' | 'shimmeropen' | 'shimmer') => void;

export function runShimmerPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, onStage?: ShimmerStageCallback): void {
  const w = st.w, h = st.h;
  const ws = Math.floor(gs.worldSurface), rl = Math.floor(gs.rockLevel);
  // cs:15259-15268:深度带
  const yLoBase = Math.trunc((ws + rl) / 2) + 50;
  let yHi = Math.trunc(((h - 250) * 2 + rl) / 3);
  if (yHi > h - 330 - 100 - 30) yHi = h - 330 - 100 - 30;
  if (yHi <= yLoBase) yHi = yLoBase + 50;
  const pickX = (wide: boolean): number =>
    gs.dungeonSide < 1
      ? rng.int(Math.trunc(w * (wide ? 0.8 : 0.89)), w - 201)
      : rng.int(200, Math.trunc(w * (wide ? 0.2 : 0.11)) - 1);
  // ★cs:15273-15274 首掷是 Y 先 X 后(与重试环内的顺序一致;重试环 cs:15291-15292 同为 Y 先)
  let y = rng.int(yLoBase, yHi - 1);
  let x = pickX(false);
  let tries = 0;
  while (!shimmerMakeBiome(st, rng, gs, x, y, onStage)) {
    tries++;
    if (tries > 20000) {
      // cs:15292-15295:放宽 x 带(0.8w/w-200 或 200/0.2w),y 下限 ws+100+20
      y = rng.int(ws + 100 + 20, yHi - 1);
      x = pickX(true);
    } else {
      // cs:15297-15300:y 下限 (ws+rl)/2+20,x 带不变
      y = rng.int(Math.trunc((ws + rl) / 2) + 20, yHi - 1);
      x = pickX(false);
    }
  }
  gs.shimmerX = x;
  gs.shimmerY = y;
  // ★cs:15307 structures.AddProtectedStructure(Rectangle(num5-100, num4-100, 200, 200))
  //   （pad 默认 0）：微光以太 200×200 登记为保护区——蜂巢主巢/蜂蜜斑/神龛/地下小屋
  //   等后续结构的 CanPlace 与之互斥（num5=X/num4=Y,矩形中心即落点）。
  addProtectedStructure(gs, { x0: x - 100, y0: y - 100, x1: x + 100, y1: y + 100 }, 0);
}

/** cs:34889-35056 ShimmerMakeBiome 主体 */
function shimmerMakeBiome(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, X: number, Y: number, onStage?: ShimmerStageCallback): boolean {
  void gs;
  const variant = rng.int(0, 1); // genRand.Next(2)
  let n2 = 0.6, n3 = 1.3, n4 = 0.3;
  if (variant === 0) { n2 = 0.55; n3 = 2.0; }
  n2 *= 1.05 - rng.next() * 0.1;
  n3 *= 1.05 - rng.next() * 0.1;
  n4 *= 1.0 - rng.next() * 0.1;
  const n5 = rng.int(105, 124); // Next(105,125)
  const n6 = Math.trunc(n5 * n4);
  const n7 = Math.trunc(n5 * n2);
  const n8 = rng.int(9, 12);    // Next(9,13)
  let x0 = X - n5, x1 = X + n5, y0 = Y - n5, y1 = Y + n5;
  // cs:34912-34924:越界(50 边距)或含猩红/腐化石 → false
  for (let k = y0; k <= y1; k++) {
    for (let l = x0; l <= x1; l++) {
      if (!st.inBounds(l, k) || l < 50 || k < 50 || l >= st.w - 50 || k >= st.h - 50) return false;
      const t = st.type[st.idx(l, k)];
      if (t === CRIMSTONE || t === EBONSTONE) return false;
    }
  }
  let n13 = Y, n14 = Y - n8;
  // cs:34925-34934:主体塑形前的 num13/num14 预掷(各 1×Next(4),命中再补 1×Next(2);
  // ★num14 预掷是减号 Y-n8-Next(2),环内是加号 Y-n8+Next(2))
  if (rng.int(0, 3) === 0) n13 = Y - rng.int(0, 1);
  if (rng.int(0, 3) === 0) n14 = Y - n8 - rng.int(0, 1);
  // cs:34935-35050:主体塑形
  for (let k = y0; k <= y1; k++) {
    for (let l = x0; l <= x1; l++) {
      const i = st.idx(l, k);
      st.liquid[i] = 0;
      if (rng.int(0, 3) === 0) n13 = Y - rng.int(0, 1);
      if (rng.int(0, 3) === 0) n14 = Y - n8 + rng.int(0, 1);
      // num15:上半纵压 1.4 / 下半 1.2(各 ±2% 抖动)
      let n15 = Math.trunc(Math.sqrt(
        (Math.abs(l - X) * (1 + rng.next() * 0.02)) ** 2 +
        (Math.abs(k - Y) * (k <= Y ? 1.4 : 1.2) * (1 + rng.next() * 0.02)) ** 2,
      ));
      if (n15 < n5) {
        st.slope[i] = 0; st.half[i] = 0;
        st.type[i] = STONE;
        if (l > x0 + 5 + rng.int(0, 1) && l < x1 - 5 - rng.int(0, 1)) st.flags[i] = 1;
        if (n15 < n5 * 0.9) st.wall[i] = 0;
      }
      n15 = Math.trunc(Math.sqrt(
        (Math.abs(l - X) * (1 + rng.next() * 0.02)) ** 2 +
        (Math.abs(k - Y) * n3 * (1 + rng.next() * 0.02)) ** 2,
      ));
      if (k > n14 && k < n13) st.flags[i] = 0;
      if (k < n13 && n15 < Math.trunc(n7 * (1 + rng.next() * 0.02))) st.flags[i] = 0;
      n15 = Math.trunc(Math.sqrt(
        (Math.abs(l - X) * (1 + rng.next() * 0.02)) ** 2 +
        (Math.abs(k - Y) * 2 * (1 + rng.next() * 0.02)) ** 2,
      ));
      if (k < Y - 1 || n15 >= Math.trunc(n6 * (1 + rng.next() * 0.025))) continue;
      if (k <= Y + 2 || n15 !== n6 - 1 || rng.int(0, 1) !== 0) st.flags[i] = 0;
      if (k >= Y) {
        st.liquid[i] = k === Y ? 127 : 255;
        st.liquidType[i] = LIQ_SHIMMER;
      }
    }
  }
  // 检查点：主体塑形环完（cs:34996 环出口 = oracle Checkpoint("shimmershell")）
  onStage?.('shimmershell');
  // cs:35020-35046:variant==0 的地表石柱列(两侧聚拢的土丘+石笋)
  if (variant === 0) {
    x0 = Math.trunc(X - n5 * n4) - rng.int(-15, 0) - 5;
    x1 = Math.trunc(X + n5 * n4) + rng.int(0, 15);
    let num16 = 0;
    for (let m = x0; m < x1; m += rng.int(9, 13)) {
      let n17 = Y - 3;
      while (st.inBounds(m, n17) && !st.flags[st.idx(m, n17)]) n17--;
      if (!st.inBounds(m, n17)) continue;
      n17 -= 4;
      let n18 = rng.int(5, 9);   // Next(5,10)
      let n19 = rng.int(15, 20); // Next(15,21)
      // cs:35013:n 在 while 前初始化、每轮内层 for 重赋 m-n18——
      // 退出时保留最后一轮内层 for 的初值(而非循环后的 n18)
      let n = m - n18;
      while (n18 > 0) {
        for (n = m - n18; n < m + n18; n++) {
          if (!st.inBounds(n, n17)) continue;
          const ti = st.idx(n, n17);
          st.type[ti] = STONE; st.flags[ti] = 1;
        }
        num16++;
        if (rng.int(0, 2) < num16) { num16 = 0; n18--; m += rng.int(-1, 1); }
        if (n19 <= 0) n18--;
        n19--;
        n17++;
      }
      n -= rng.int(1, 2); // cs:35035:末轮内层 for 的 n 再退 Next(1,3)
      if (st.inBounds(n, n17 - 2)) { const ti = st.idx(n, n17 - 2); st.type[ti] = STONE; st.flags[ti] = 1; }
      if (st.inBounds(n, n17 - 1)) { const ti = st.idx(n, n17 - 1); st.type[ti] = STONE; st.flags[ti] = 1; }
      if (st.inBounds(n, n17)) { const ti = st.idx(n, n17); st.type[ti] = STONE; st.flags[ti] = 1; }
      if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) {
        if (st.inBounds(n, n17 + 1)) { const ti = st.idx(n, n17 + 1); st.type[ti] = STONE; st.flags[ti] = 1; }
        placeTight(st, rng, n, n17 + 2);
      } else {
        placeTight(st, rng, n, n17 + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  // 检查点：石柱列完（variant≠0 时同态跳过 = oracle Checkpoint("shimmerpillars")）
  onStage?.('shimmerpillars');
  // cs:35054-35055:两侧隧道开口
  shimmerOpening(st, rng, -1, X - n5, Y, n8);
  shimmerOpening(st, rng, 1, X + n5, Y, n8);
  // 检查点：两侧隧道开口完（cs:35055 后 = oracle Checkpoint("shimmeropen")）
  onStage?.('shimmeropen');
  // cs:35057-35083:aether 宝石树——500 次 X±70/Y±2 采样,两侧 SolidTile 才种。
  // ★tileSolid 走 GenSolid：659 以太石块自 Reset（cs:11500）起生成期恒非实心——
  //   原版 cs:35091 `SolidTile(num22±1, num23)` 读可变数组,**不会**把树种在以太
  //   石块上;静态 TILE_DEFS.solid 会（v_659 数据仍 solid:true）,已校正
  const solidTile = (x: number, y: number): boolean => {
    if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return false;
    const i = st.idx(x, y);
    if (!st.flags[i]) return false;
    const d = TILE_DEFS[st.type[i]];
    return genSolidType(st.type[i]) && !!d && !d.platform && !st.half[i] && st.slope[i] === 0;
  };
  for (let n = 0; n < 500; n++) {
    const tx = rng.int(X - 70, X + 69);              // Next(X-70, X+70)
    const ty = rng.int(Y - 2, Y + 2);                // Next(Y-2, Y+3)
    const treeType = GEM_TREES[rng.int(0, 6)];       // num24=Next(7)（SolidTile 判定前消耗，保持流位）
    if (!solidTile(tx - 1, ty) || !solidTile(tx + 1, ty)) continue;
    growGemTree(st, rng, tx, ty, treeType);
  }
  // 检查点：aether 宝石树种完（cs:35091 循环出口 = oracle Checkpoint("shimmer")）
  onStage?.('shimmer');
  return true;
}

/** cs:35095-35125 ShimmerMakeBiomeOpening */
function shimmerOpening(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, dir: number, X: number, Y: number, size: number): void {
  let num = X;
  let y = Y;
  size--;
  // 原版此处是 WorldGen.SolidTile（cs:35102/35112,读可变 tileSolid）——659 以太石块
  // 生成期非实心（cs:11500）,隧道开口可穿以太石本体。旧近似只查 active（flags）,
  // 已校正为 GenSolid 口径（active && 生成期 tileSolid）
  const solidAt = (x: number, yy: number) =>
    st.inBounds(x, yy) && st.flags[st.idx(x, yy)] !== 0 && genSolidType(st.type[st.idx(x, yy)]);
  for (;;) {
    num += dir;
    let open = true;
    for (let i = y - size + 1; i < y - 1; i++) {
      if (solidAt(num, i)) open = false;
      if (solidAt(num + dir, i)) open = false;
      if (solidAt(num + dir * 2, i)) open = false;
      if (st.inBounds(num, i)) st.flags[st.idx(num, i)] = 0;
    }
    for (let j = y - size; j < y; j++) {
      if (st.inBounds(num - dir, j)) st.flags[st.idx(num - dir, j)] = 0;
    }
    if (solidAt(num - dir, y - size - 1) && st.inBounds(num - dir, y - size - 1)) st.wall[st.idx(num - dir, y - size - 1)] = 0;
    if (solidAt(num - dir, y) && st.inBounds(num - dir, y)) st.wall[st.idx(num - dir, y)] = 0;
    if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) y += rng.int(-1, 1);
    if (open || num < 50 || num > st.w - 50 || Math.abs(num - X) > 100) break;
  }
}

/** PlaceTight（1456 cs:38329，spiders=false）1:1。
 *  门禁：!anyShimmer(x,y) && (!active(x,y) || type!=231 幼虫) → 掷 Next(2) preferSmall +
 *  Next(3) variation（门禁过即掷，放置成败都消费）。上方实心 → 垂挂钟乳石；否则下方实心
 *  且上方净空 → 地面石笋（spiders 路径在 HiveSpiderPass.placeTightWebs）。
 *  导出给 SpeleothemsAndGemTrees pass（cs:22196，GemPasses 消费）复用。 */
export function placeTight(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number): void {
  const yi = st.idx(x, y);
  const liq = st.liquid[yi];
  if (liq > 0 && st.liquidType[yi] === LIQ_SHIMMER) return;
  if (st.flags[yi] && st.type[yi] === stLarva()) return;
  const preferSmall = rng.int(0, 1) === 0;   // genRand.Next(2) == 0
  const variation = rng.int(0, 2);           // genRand.Next(3)
  placeUncheckedStalactite(st, x, y, preferSmall, variation);
  // PlaceTight 尾（cs:38345）：placed 165 → CheckStalactite——本仓库 placeUncheckedStalactite
  // 直写"重定型后"的最终列（材质匹配族 style==desired 不掷）；初始列≠期望列的失配族
  // （117/25/203/163/164/200）原版 UpdateStalagtiteStyle 重掷 1×Next(3)——此处补掷
  if (st.flags[yi] && st.type[yi] === STALACTITE) {
    checkStalactite(st, rng, x, y);
  }
}

// ── CheckStalactite（cs:39022）/ UpdateStalagtiteStyle（cs:38669）/ KillTile-165 ──
// 石笋生命周期：放置即查（PlaceTight 尾）+ 后续 TileFrame 重查（TileFrameImportant
// case 165）——支撑被 SmoothSlope 上坡/半砖后 SolidTile 翻假 → 整体击杀（含双格伴生）。
// 击杀改写状态且经 SquareTileFrame 级联重查邻居 165；UpdateStalagtiteStyle 仅在
// style != desiredStyle 时掷 1×Next(3)（cs:38690）。缺失时大理石钟乳石存活数与
// 原版分叉 → SolidTile 门/SmoothSlope mask 级联放大（biome 内流整体错位）。
const STYLE_BY_FX54 = new Map<number, number>([
  [0, 7], [1, 0], [2, 11], [3, 12], [4, 1], [5, 2], [6, 3], [7, 4],
  [8, 5], [9, 6], [10, 8], [11, 9], [12, 10],
]);
/** 期望 style 的列基（UpdateStalagtiteStyle switch cs:38696-38720） */
const FX_BASE_BY_STYLE = [54, 216, 270, 324, 378, 432, 486, 0, 540, 594, 648, 108, 162];

/** GetDesiredStalagtiteStyle（cs:38746-38847）：按 frameY 形态取支撑格，
 *  return null = fail2（UpdateStalagtiteStyle 返 false → 击杀）。 */
function getDesiredStalagtiteStyle(
  st: TileStore, x: number, j: number,
): { fail: boolean; style: number; height: number; y: number } {
  const i0 = st.idx(x, j);
  const fy = st.frameY[i0]!;
  let num = 0, y = j, height = 1;
  let supSheet: number;
  if (fy === 72) {
    num = 0;
    supSheet = sheetActive(st, x, j - 1);
  } else if (fy === 90) {
    num = 1;
    supSheet = sheetActive(st, x, j + 1);
  } else if (fy >= 36) {
    if (fy === 54) y--;
    height = 2;
    num = 4;
    supSheet = sheetActive(st, x, y + 2);
  } else {
    if (fy === 18) y--;
    height = 2;
    num = 3;
    supSheet = sheetActive(st, x, y - 1);
  }
  if (supSheet === 1 || MOSS_SHEETS.has(supSheet)) {
    return { fail: false, style: num === 3 && st.wall[i0] === 62 ? 11 : 0, height, y };
  }
  switch (supSheet) {
    case 200: return { fail: false, style: 10, height, y };
    case 164: return { fail: false, style: 8, height, y };
    case 163: return { fail: false, style: 9, height, y };
    case 117: case 402: case 403: return { fail: false, style: 1, height, y };
    case 25: case 398: case 400: return { fail: false, style: 2, height, y };
    case 203: case 399: case 401: return { fail: false, style: 3, height, y };
    case 396: case 397: return { fail: false, style: 4, height, y };
    case 367: return { fail: false, style: 6, height, y };
    case 368: return { fail: false, style: 5, height, y };
    case 147: case 161: return { fail: false, style: 7, height, y };
  }
  if ((num === 0 || num === 1) && supSheet === 225) return { fail: false, style: 12, height, y };
  return { fail: true, style: 0, height, y };

function spreadJungleGrass(st: TileStore, i: number, j: number): void {
  if (i < 10 || i >= st.w - 10 || j < 10 || j >= st.h - 10) return;
  const ii = st.idx(i, j);
  if (!st.flags[ii] || st.type[ii] !== MUD) return;
  let flag = true;
  outer: for (let k = i - 1; k <= i + 1; k++) {
    for (let l = j - 1; l <= j + 1; l++) {
      const ki = st.idx(k, l);
      if (!st.flags[ki] || !vanGenSolidType(st.type[ki])) flag = false;
      if (st.liquid[ki] > 0 && st.liquidType[ki] === 2) { flag = true; break outer; }
    }
  }
  if (flag) return;
  st.type[ii] = JUNGLE_GRASS;   // type=60（SquareTileFrame 无 dump 通道影响、零掷）
  if (grassSpreadDepth >= 1000) return;
  grassSpreadDepth++;
  for (let k = i - 1; k <= i + 1; k++) {
    for (let l = j - 1; l <= j + 1; l++) {
      const ki = st.idx(k, l);
      if (st.flags[ki] && st.type[ki] === MUD) spreadJungleGrass(st, k, l);
    }
  }
  grassSpreadDepth--;
}

This includes: WallFrameDraw, SquareWallFrameDraw, SquareWallFrameRoll, SolidOrSlopedGen, Solid5Gen, CanPoundGen, SmoothSlopeCore, SmoothSlopeDesert, SmoothSlopeSlab(Self), stalactite family, Check3x2 family. Note: C# top-level statements — local functions can be declared after use? NO — local functions CAN be used before declaration in C# (they're not lambdas)! Actually in C#, local functions CAN be called before their declaration site within the same scope. Yes — "Unlike a method definition, a local function definition can appear after the call site". So placement is flexible. But local VARIABLES (like `r`, `SOLID`) must be declared before use in the execution flow — helpers referencing them are fine as long as declaration precedes first invocation. My helpers are function declarations, not invocations — safe.

BUT — one problem: `WallFrameDraw` etc. are local functions in the top-level scope; they can access `r`, `wal`, etc. ✓. And later `Replay()` reassigns `r` — local functions capture the variable, not the value ✓.

function invalidForPiles(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {
  if (!inWorld(st, x, y, 2)) return false;
  return activeAt(st, x, y) && PILE_BOULDERS.has(sheetAt(st, x, y));
}

/** WorldGen.Place3x2（cs:52097,经 PlaceTile case 187 cs:60016 派发）：3×2
 *  **底中锚** (x-1..x+1)×(y-1..y)——此前误按底左锚整体右移 1 列；足印全空 +
function solidAt(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {
  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return false;
  const i = st.idx(x, y);
  // 生成期实心查询（GenSolid）：GrowLivingTree 体内 48 尖刺已翻非实心（cs:28257），
  // 裸 TILE_DEFS.solid 会把尖刺当实心挡树（见 growLivingTree 内翻转注释）
  return st.flags[i] !== 0 && genSolidType(st.type[i]);
}

 *  这对 PoundTile（toggle 语义）至关重要：已砸的半砖不会被后续 pass 再"砸回"整砖。
 *  ★tileSolid 走 GenSolid（生成期 Main.tileSolid 翻转表）：SmoothWorld 期间 137
 *  陷阱（cs:16212 起非实心）/190 荧光菇块（cs:16693 起非实心）/484 滚动仙人掌
 *  （cs:12537 起非实心）等不再被当实心地面——与原版 SolidTile 读可变数组一致 */
export function solidTile(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {
  if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= st.w || y >= st.h) return false;
  const i = st.idx(x, y);
  // 原版 SolidTile 检查 active()（=flags）：TileRunner 幽灵 tile（有 type 无 flags）
  // 不得当实心——曾致补角分支实体化天空幽灵块成浮空半砖（2583 个）
  if (!st.flags[i]) return false;
  const t = st.type[i];
  if (t === 0) return false;
  const d = TILE_DEFS[t];
  return genSolidType(t) && !!d && !d.platform && !st.half[i] && st.slope[i] === 0;
}

```
